lessons.title: Let's plan!

items.exampleMeaning: What are you doing tomorrow?
I am going to meet a friend.
We meet at three o'clock.

items.example: Vi har en fest på lördag.
items.exampleMeaning: We have a party on Saturday.

items.meaning: Do you want to come along?
items.example: Vill du följa med till parken?
items.exampleMeaning: Do you want to come along to the park?
Yes, please! I will come.

lessons.tip: When talking about future plans, use 'ska' to express intentions. Remember to mention the time or day for clarity.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a friend making plans for Saturday.
scenario.learnerRole: B is the learner confirming their plans.
scenario.brief: Fråga vad B gör på lördag och bjud in dem. Använd 'ska' och tid.
scenario.goal: You need to confirm your plans for Saturday.

lessons.title: Invitations and replies

items.exampleMeaning: Thank you for the invitation to the party!
Unfortunately, I cannot come.
Maybe later in the week.
What time does the party start?

items.example: Det låter kul att gå på konsert.
items.exampleMeaning: That sounds fun to go to a concert.
I am free on Sunday.

lessons.tip: Use 'tyvärr' to politely decline an invitation. You can also express interest with 'det låter kul!'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Thank you for the invitation to the party!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: What time does the party start?

scenario.partnerRole: A is inviting B to a party.
scenario.learnerRole: B is responding to the invitation.
scenario.brief: Fråga om B kan komma och ge dem alternativ.
scenario.goal: You need to respond to the invitation.

lessons.title: Making specific plans

items.exampleMeaning: We can go to the cinema.
Let’s meet at five o'clock.
How does that sound to you?

items.example: Jag föredrar att gå på lördag.
items.exampleMeaning: I prefer to go on Saturday.
Can we meet earlier?

items.example: Det är en bra idé att åka tidigt.
items.exampleMeaning: That is a good idea to leave early.

lessons.tip: When suggesting plans, use 'vi kan' or 'låt oss'. This makes your suggestion more inviting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: We can go to the cinema.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Jag föredrar att gå på lördag.
dialogue.meaning: I prefer to go on Saturday.

scenario.partnerRole: A is suggesting plans for a movie.
scenario.brief: Fråga om tid och preferenser för att träffas.
scenario.goal: You need to suggest a time to meet.

lessons.title: Confirming plans

items.exampleMeaning: Are we agreed on the time?

items.example: Jag ser fram emot att träffas!
items.exampleMeaning: I look forward to meeting!

items.example: Skriv ner det i din kalender.
items.exampleMeaning: Write it down in your calendar.
See you then on Saturday.

items.example: Kom ihåg att ta med biljetterna.
items.exampleMeaning: Remember to bring the tickets.

items.example: Det är bestämt att vi åker.
items.exampleMeaning: It is decided that we are going.

lessons.tip: Use 'är vi överens?' to confirm plans. This helps to ensure everyone is on the same page.
